title: 7 Ways a Godly Man's Work Proves He's Walking Humbly
caption:
Humility isn't a posture you hold in your quiet time. It shows up on a Tuesday at work, in the small calls nobody's grading.

He takes correction from someone junior without getting defensive. He gives the idea away without needing his name on it, because the credit was never the point. He does the job nobody wants before he's handed the one everybody wants, and he asks a question instead of pretending he already knows. He stays late for someone else's deadline, owns a mistake out loud before someone else finds it, and works the same whether the boss is watching or God is the only one who is.

It's not the promotion. It's what he does after it.
